parts.text:
Yes, you can sign up for the free trial, but here is what happens when you do:

### **Key Details:**
* **Trial Duration:** 14 days.
* **Cost & Billing:** It is free for the first 14 days, but **automatically converts into a paid subscription of $49.99/month** once the trial ends.
* **Payment Card Required:** You must provide payment details upfront, and your card will be charged automatically unless you cancel in time.
* **Reversibility:** You can cancel before the 14-day trial ends to avoid any charges.

### **Important Fine Print Considerations:**
* **Buried Clauses:** Automatic renewal and billing details are stated in the fine print (Terms §2).
* **Urgency Claims:** Any countdown timer or scarcity claims regarding the trial offer may be artificial.

If you decide to sign up, set a reminder to cancel before the 14-day window expires if you do not wish to continue with the paid monthly subscription.

parts.text:
Here is the inspection of the cookie choices on this page, followed by confirmation of the privacy setting updated for you:

---

### **1. Decision Group Breakdown**

| Choice | Default State | Data Shared | Financial Cost | Policy Reference |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Accept All** (`cookie-accept`) | Unselected | Browsing activity, device identifiers (shared with ~40 ad partners) | $0 | *Cookie notice: advertising-partner sharing* |
| **Partner Sharing** (`cookie-partners-row`) | **Selected (Default)** | Browsing activity, device identifiers, advertising partner IDs | $0 | *Cookie notice: partner sharing* |
| **Reject All / Essential Only** (`cookie-reject`) | Unselected | **None** (essential cookies only) | $0 | *Cookie notice: essential cookies only* |

---

### **2. Summary of Findings**

* **Costs:** None of the cookie choices involve financial commitments or recurring charges.
* **Defaults:** The option to share activity with advertising partners (`cookie-partners-row`) is enabled by default.
* **Alternatives:** You can accept all tracking, selectively disable partner sharing, or reject all non-essential cookies.
* **Reversibility:** All cookie selections can be reversed/updated at any time.

---

### **3. Action Taken**

I have set your privacy preference to **Essential Cookies Only** (`cookie-reject`). No browsing activity or device identifiers will be shared with advertising partners.
